propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner currently iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with reviewer_id but no logical criterion_id, preventing activated project criteria from entering Round A/B workflow
Project criteria must execute exactly once in Round A only, never in Round B, and findings must carry both physical reviewer_id provenance and logical criterion_id attribution

gate_dispatch must assemble active LLM-tier project criteria by reading registry.effective_criteria and registry.effective_routing, resolving each criterion_prompt_id, and passing project_criteria tuple to the runner
CodeReviewBatchRunner must combine req.criteria with project_criteria only when req.step_id == 'round_a' to prevent double execution and maintain stateless deterministic retries
Missing or malformed project criterion prompt must fail loudly with a located LLMError naming the logical criterion and expected .rebar/prompts path
